Interface ICause

public interface ICause
A list of causes that lead to something happening.This is a immutable state (therefore will not be modified). If an addition is required, then a new object is required.

Typically used with events to state why the event was triggered and what came before.

An example of a cause trace would be if a block is moved by a piston, but the piston was activated by redstone which leads to a redstone switch and that switch was activated by a player, then the following would be within the list.

  1. Connection who activated the switch
  2. The human Entity.Live who activated the switch
  3. The redstone switch BlockData.LocatableBlockData
  4. The redstone BlockData.LocatableBlockData
  5. The piston BlockData.LocatableBlockData

This means to get the player who moved the block, all you need to do is listen to the piston move block event and then get the cause of the event and search for the first(Class) Connection provided
